notes.title: Blue Wednesday Prologue Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43696269/90515bcacac144a7addad18d6ccf818106395497.png

Hey everyone,

We've added new content and features to the Blue Wednesday Prologue. 
Check out the update to experience them! 


Here's a list some of the changes:


New Features:
Added save system: separate save files.
Added the new UI system

 Controller selection 
 Customize Key Presets
 Vinyl Collection 
 Collect Sheet Music 
 Characters information: currently inactive. 

Modified 

 Improved Rhythm game logic
 Improved NPC Behaviour
 Improved Event system 



Content Update: 

Added a short tutorial and improved directing.
Added side character histories and minigames. 
While enjoying the main story, you can also interact with the characters around you to gain more experience and enjoy the game. 


And lots more!  Play the game to read the full list of changes!
